From: controls@nebula-tech.com
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: CAIQ export — inconsistent subcontrol IDs and missing provenance

Hi Olga,

We ran the CAIQ extractor you provided against our internal environment and noticed several issues in the CSV export:

- Rows where Subcontrol ID is blank or appears as a different formatting (e.g., 'SC-8.1' vs 'SC-8.01').
- A number of controls reference evidence files that do not appear in the zip (placeholders only).
- The tool produced duplicate mappings for certain controls (networking / edge controls).

I've attached the raw CSV we received from the extractor run: nebula_caiq_export_20270214.csv.

We need a short recon on provenance and an owner-by-subcontrol breakdown so our auditor can complete the review. Can you confirm if this is a generator bug or a CSV parsing/normalization mismatch?

Thanks — please cc our auditor.

--
Alex Mercer
Controls Lead, Nebula Tech
controls@nebula-tech.com
[Attachment: nebula_caiq_export_20270214.csv (csv)]

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: controls@nebula-tech.com, auditor@brightline-audit.com
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 11:03:15 -0800
Subject: Re: CAIQ export — inconsistent subcontrol IDs and missing provenance

Thanks Alex — received and reproduced locally. Quick summary of what I see after a first pass: 

- The extraction pipeline normalizes subcontrol IDs using a heuristic that strips punctuation and leading zeros; that explains 'SC-8.01' -> 'SC801' style collisions in the intermediate mapping.
- A later step is supposed to map normalized IDs back to canonical IDs, but the reverse-lookup fails for non-standard prefixes we started seeing in Nebula's CAIQ template (they have a custom prefixing convention for some legacy controls).
- Evidence placeholders in the CSV are produced when the upstream evidence pull fails (usually an API timeout or a path mismatch). I compared timestamps and saw a handful of 5xx responses during your export window.

Action items I propose below. I attached my snapshot of the extractor mapping for the run: mapping_snapshot_olga_20270214.json.

---
Olga (internal notes / proposed plan):
1) Jonas: run controlled retry of the evidence pull with extended timeouts and capture full request/response logs (ETA 1 business day).
2) Olga: produce canonicalization patch to ensure the mapping retains original subcontrol tokens (non-destructive) and emits both normalized and canonical columns (ETA 2 business days).
3) Marissa: coordinate communication with Nebula and the auditor; share interim reconciliation table and target remediation window (ETA today EOD for status update).

Alex / Brightline: we will provide a short provenance summary and a corrected CSV within 48 hours. If you need it faster, tell us the auditor priority.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Security & Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: mapping_snapshot_olga_20270214.json (json)]
